body.name: Rational quotient-table and backpointer certificate
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Cert}(G,K,\Sigma,\mathcal T)\) lists every finite \((t,q,D_t(q),P_t(q))\), every locally charged rational summand indexed by \(H_t\), and the accepted root entry \((\varnothing,\varnothing,K)\).  Its backpointers reconstruct the optimal unlabeled blocks; ordering those blocks by their least vertex gives the reported labeled optimizer \(\mathcal C^\star\).  For the rank-compressed table the certificate additionally lists every retained cut row and its deterministic \(\mathbb F_2\)-elimination pivot.
